claude.sample_unit: pediatric ESS patients (633 development, 152 external validation)

links.outcome: Calibration in external cohort before and after logistic recalibration
links.effect: External validation showed systematic miscalibration; logistic recalibration restored calibration with essentially unchanged discrimination (AUC 0.756).
links.quote: Logistic recalibration restored calibration with essentially unchanged discrimination.

links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration on independent external validation cohort
links.effect: Model maintained discrimination (AUC 0.756 vs 0.689 in development) but showed systematic miscalibration in the external cohort (recurrence 30.3% vs 38.2%).
links.quote: On external validation, the model maintained discrimination (AUC = 0.756) but showed systematic miscalibration.

links.effect: L1-optimized LR achieved AUC of 0.689, comparable to four class-weighted models.
links.quote: The L1-optimized LR model retained three predictors-nasal polyps, a higher Lund-Mackay CT score, and diffuse extent-each associated with higher recurrence risk, and achieved an AUC of 0.689, comparable to that of the other four class-weighted models.
